title: Opportunity to be heard
summary: An opportunity to be heard allows an affected person to challenge the grounds for governmental action before an appropriate decision-maker. Timing and the form of the hearing depend on the legal setting.
notes: The due-process cases do not prescribe a full trial before every temporary measure. The kind of property, prior interest, evidentiary showing, decision-maker, and available prompt review matter.

sections.How to work through the question: Identify the private interest, the risk that the procedure will produce an erroneous deprivation, the usefulness of additional safeguards, and the countervailing interests. Distinguish ordinary private creditor collection from extraordinary situations requiring immediate action.
